'''Barada K'lar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who served as a docking control agent operating out of [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Treema]]. In [[44 ABY]], he welcomed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vestara Khai]] to Klatooine.
